candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(owner) check so any caller can initialize owner's balance by calling XBornID, changing balances for caller or others.
Replace decrement of allowed[_from][msg.sender] with no update so allowance is not reduced by transferFrom.
Replace decrement of allowed[_from][msg.sender] with setting allowance to zero, so transferFrom always clears allowance for that pair.
Replace decrement of allowed[_from][msg.sender] with increasing the allowance by the transferred amount, effectively giving more allowance after transferFrom.
Replace assert check with a stricter require that will revert on too-small payloads instead of asserting.
Replace assert check with a no-op (remove payload size validation), altering which calls are allowed and thus who can call transferFrom.
